Was haben ein Top-Mountainbike, ein künstliches Hüftgelenk und ein Smartphone gemeinsam? Wir entwickeln die Software, um diese High-End-Produkte herzustellen! Mit hyperMILL® steuern wir CNC-Maschinen und haben höchste Ansprüche an Leistung und Teilequalität.
Wir sind einer der weltweit führenden Entwickler von leistungsstarken CAD/CAM-Lösungen – und das seit mehr als 30 Jahren! Unsere innovativen CAD/CAM-Technologien sorgen für eine deutlich höhere Performance im Programmierprozess und setzen internationale Maßstäbe in der zerspanenden Fertigung.
Für unser Produktmanagement suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen erfahrenen Produktmanager (m/w/d) mit starkem Verständnis für zerspanende Prozesse und der 2.5D, 3-Achs und 5-Achs-Bearbeitung.
Ihre Tätigkeitsschwerpunkte
Identifikation, Priorisierung und Validierung von Kundenanforderungen, Marktpotenzialen und technologischen Chancen im Bereich 2.5D-, 3-Achs- und 5-Achs-Bearbeitung
Begleitung der Produktentwicklung von der Problemdefinition und Discovery über die Konzeption bis zur erfolgreichen Markteinführung neuer Funktionen und Lösungen
Bewertung von Anforderungen hinsichtlich Kundennutzen, technischer Machbarkeit und strategischer Relevanz sowie aktive Mitgestaltung der Produktstrategie
Absicherung neuer Konzepte und Lösungen durch Kundenfeedback, Praxistests sowie strukturierte Risikoanalysen
Zusammenarbeit mit Entwicklung, QA, Anwendungstechnik, Support, Marketing und Vertrieb zur Sicherstellung einer konsistenten und erfolgreichen Produktentwicklung

Sicherstellung der konsistenten Integration neuer Funktionen in Bezug auf User Experience, Produktstrategie und hyperMILL-Gesamtkonzept sowie Verantwortung für die Erreichung definierter Produktziele und die nachhaltige Verbesserung des Kundennutzens
Ihr Profil
Tiefgreifendes Wissen in der Zerspanung sowie fundiertes Verständnis von CAM-Prozessen, CNC-Maschinen, Steuerungen, Werkzeugen und Fertigungsabläufen
Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im CAM-, Zerspanungs- oder Produktmanagementumfeld sowie Erfahrung in der Entwicklung, Validierung und Markteinführung technischer Produktlösungen
Souveräne Bewertung von Anforderungen, Risiken und Prioritäten sowie Fähigkeit zur verständlichen Aufbereitung komplexer technischer Sachverhalte
Sicheres Agieren im Austausch mit Kunden sowie interdisziplinären Teams und Stakeholdern

Wir von Platri IT suchen Verstärkung im Bereich Product Ownership. Wir sind ein engagiertes und aufgeschlossenes Team mit Startup-Flair aus Bochum.
Neben der Entwicklung individueller Software in Form von Web-, App- und Plattformlösungen entwickeln wir eigene Softwareideen und begleiten digitale Produkte von der ersten Vision bis zum erfolgreichen Go-live.
Du studierst aktuell und möchtest nicht nur theoretisch lernen, wie digitale Produkte entstehen, sondern aktiv an echten Softwareprojekten mitarbeiten? Du hast Freude daran, Anforderungen zu verstehen, Nutzerbedürfnisse zu erkennen und gemeinsam mit Entwicklern und Designern aus Ideen funktionierende Software zu machen? Dann könnte Platri IT genau das Richtige für dich sein.
Warum Platri IT?
Jung & Trendy: Wir sind mehr als nur eine Agentur für Softwareentwicklung. Seit 2019 gestalten wir aktiv die digitale Welt, indem wir unsere Kunden unterstützen, bahnbrechende Web- und Mobileanwendungen zu kreieren.
User-First: Bei uns stehen die Kunden im Mittelpunkt. Ob Online-Portal, Business-App, E-Commerce-Lösung oder komplexe Webanwendung – wir bringen Technologie und Nutzererfahrung auf ein neues Level.
Startup Vibes: Werde Teil unserer Zentrale in Bochum und arbeite in einem Umfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, flachen Hierarchien und viel Raum für eigene Ideen. Tauche ein in die pulsierende Startup-Szene Deutschlands.
Vielfältige Projekte: Bei uns arbeitest du an spannenden Projekten aus unterschiedlichen Branchen – von Startups bis hin zu etablierten Unternehmen. Dabei lernst du verschiedene Geschäftsmodelle, Zielgruppen und technische Anforderungen kennen und bekommst einen echten Einblick in die Entwicklung individueller Softwarelösungen.
Aufgaben
Deine Mission?
Unterstütze unsere Product Owner bei der Planung und Steuerung individueller Softwareprojekte.
Lerne die Ziele, Geschäftsprozesse und Nutzergruppen unserer Kunden kennen.
Begleite interne Abstimmungen sowie Termine zur Entwicklung von Produktvisionen, Anforderungen und Konzepten.
Unterstütze bei der Übersetzung von Anforderungen in User Stories.
Hilf bei der Pflege, Strukturierung und Vorbereitung des Product Backlogs.
Bereite Refinements, Sprint Plannings, Reviews und weitere agile Termine mit vor.
Unterstütze dabei, Anforderungen eindeutig zu formulieren und offene Punkte nachzuhalten.
Hilf bei der Abnahme entwickelter Funktionen und unterstütze die Qualitätssicherung.
Dokumentiere Ergebnisse, Entscheidungen und Feedback aus Terminen.
Beobachte gemeinsam mit dem Team die Nutzung und Wirkung umgesetzter Funktionen und bringe eigene Verbesserungsideen ein.
Was macht diese Position besonders?
Echte Praxiserfahrung: Du unterstützt nicht nur im Hintergrund, sondern arbeitest aktiv an echten Softwareprojekten mit.
Einblick in Product Ownership: Du lernst, wie aus ersten Ideen konkrete Anforderungen, User Stories, Backlogs und digitale Produkte entstehen.
Direkter Impact: Deine Arbeit hilft dabei, Funktionen klarer zu definieren, Anforderungen besser zu strukturieren und Projekte erfolgreich voranzubringen.
Kundennähe: Du erhältst Einblicke in Abstimmungen, Workshops und Präsentationen und lernst, wie Kundenwünsche in eine klare Produktrichtung übersetzt werden.
Support & Learn: Fragen? Unser IT-Team steht dir stets zur Seite. Zudem garantieren wir dir ein individuell angepasstes Onboarding. Jeder Start soll einzigartig sein!
Raum für Ideen: Wir freuen uns über neue Perspektiven und geben dir die Möglichkeit, unsere Arbeitsweisen aktiv mitzugestalten.
Qualifikation
Du passt perfekt, wenn du …
…aktuell in einem passenden Studiengang eingeschrieben bist, z. B. Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, BWL, Medien, UX, Produktmanagement oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich.
…Interesse an digitalen Produkten, Softwareentwicklung und agilen Arbeitsweisen hast.
…komplexe Themen analysieren und verständlich strukturieren kannst.
…gerne mit Menschen kommunizierst und Lust auf die Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden, Anwendern und technischen Teams hast.
…neugierig bist und dich schnell in neue Themen einarbeitest.
…selbstständig, zuverlässig und lösungsorientiert arbeitest.
…erste Grundkenntnisse in agilen Methoden wie Scrum oder Kanban mitbringst oder Lust hast, diese bei uns zu lernen.
…idealerweise erste Erfahrung mit Tools wie Jira, Confluence oder Miro hast.
…Teamarbeit schätzt und dich fachlich weiterentwickeln möchtest.
…während des Semesters regelmäßig Zeit hast, unser Team zu unterstützen.

Hybrides Modell mit bis zu 50 % Remote-AnteilFlexible Arbeitszeiten, die zu deinem Studium passen
Individuell abgestimmtes Onboarding
Moderner Arbeitsplatz in BochumEquipment und moderne Hardware
Freigetränke

Kostenfreies Kursprogramm im Bereich Tanz und Meditation
Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege
Persönliche und fachliche Weiterentwicklung
Viel Raum für Eigeninitiative und neue Ideen

Wir freuen uns auf dich!

About Remote Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams.

With our core values at heart and future focused work culture, our team works tirelessly on ambitious problems, asynchronously, around the world. You can find Remote rs working from 6 different continents (Antarctica left to go!) and all of our positions are fully remote.

With Innovation as one of the core values, we have built Automation and AI capabilities into the requirements for every role. We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform.

If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work! What this job can offer you This is an exciting time to join Remote and make a personal difference in the global employment space as a Product Manager , joining our Product team in the Fintech vertical .

As a Billing Platform Product Manager, you will be a key member of our triad of product managers in the billing team, each leading their independent teams yet working within an interconnected scope. As a Product Manager at Remote , you'll be developing and guiding our strategy for a key product area in Finance.

You'll advance this vision by working with a cross-functional engineering and design group to find our most important problems and shape iterative solutions towards them. What you bring Prior experience as product manager in billing / invoicing or similar, ideally at a high-growth company Proficiency in Cursor and/or Claude Code or similar tool.

You must be able to autonomously build, debug, and ship functional prototypes or small code changes with the help of AI tooling, not just write specs.

Great judgment making both strategic (what to prioritize) and tactical (feature scope) decisions Demonstrable, self-driven results that have moved a product in the right direction A passion for creating seamless and effective products, even when the challenges they address are complex and intricate.

Outstanding communication and collaboration skills, including across different departments (e.g. business operations, sales, etc.) to ensure that we’re satisfying critical business requirements Proficient in English, both written and spoken. Bonus: Experience working in a remote environment.

Key Responsibilities Build solutions together with the rest of the team that solve for finance, billing and other financial services at Remote Own not just software implementation, but the end-to-end experience: Remote delivers value through services powered by both humans and software Lead on complex solutions without requiring support or involvement from senior members of the product team Effectively manage internal expectations for complex projects, products, and features while navigating challenging prioritization decisions Drive Remote in the right direction by building an effective roadmap and strategy for your area of the product in Finance Break down strategic plans into near and mid-term goals that's easy for others to understand Align your product roadmap with higher level department and company problems we’re working to solve Be the subject matter expert for your product area Contribute to scaling and growth plans for your product area Ship improvements quickly and iteratively, challenging yourself and counterparts to find minimal solutions to problems Support and leads a product team delivering high throughput and high return on investment Understand key business KPIs and align your team's work and metrics to directly improve to these Work together with engineers, designers and stakeholders to build solutions to important complex problems Communicate and collaborate internally and externally Contribute to the Product org by sharing your techniques, processes, and learnings Communicate and promote the work of your team and why it matters to customers and internal teams Work asynchronously and transparently Lead on solutions with minimal support or involvement from senior members of the product team.

You should be able to work autonomously on simple features and iterations, only needing support to solve complex problems Contribute to tactical and strategic decision-making for your business area Develop into a subject matter expert for understanding, articulating, and solving complex business problems related to our mobile experiences Practicals You'll report to: Group Product Manager Location : For this position we welcome everyone to apply Start date: As soon as possible Remote Compensation Philosophy Remote 's Total Rewards philosophy is to ensure fair, unbiased compensation and fair equity pay along with competitive benefits in all locations in which we operate.

We do not agree to or encourage cheap-labor practices and therefore we ensure to pay above in-location rates. We hope to inspire other companies to support global talent-hiring and bring local wealth to developing countries. At first glance our salary bands seem quite wide - here is some context.

At Remote we have international operations and a globally distributed workforce. We use geo ranges to consider geographic pay differentials as part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive in various markets while we hiring globally. The base salary range for this full-time position is $62,400 to $140,400.

Our salary ranges are determined by role, level and location, and our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay for the successful candidate in this role is dependent upon many factors such as location, transferable or job-related skills, work experience, relevant training, business needs, and market demands.

The base salary range may be subject to change. At Remote , we foster internal mobility as a key element of our culture of employee growth and development, supported by a compensation philosophy that guarantees pay equity and fairness.

Therefore, all compensation changes associated with an internal move will be reviewed by the Total Rewards & People Enablement team on a case by case basis.

At TechBiz Global, we are providing recruitment service to our TOP clients from our portfolio. We are currently seeking an Senior Product Manager specialist to join one of our clients ' teams. If you're looking for an exciting opportunity to grow in a innovative environment, this could be the perfect fit for you.
Tasks
As a Senior Product Manager you will be responsible for the success of client’s product from start to finish. Specifically, this means:
-Strategy & Roadmap: You develop a clear vision, translate company goals into tangible product objectives, and maintain a prioritized roadmap.
-Backlog & Planning: You write clear user stories, ensure the backlog remains organized, and make sure everything aligns with sprint and quarterly goals.
-Discovery & Validation: You conduct structured discovery, evaluate ideas and solutions, and derive decisions from them.
-Delivery & Quality: You work closely with Engineering and QA to ensure features are launched on time and with high quality – including test cases and release notes.
-Metrics & Impact: You define success criteria, track usage and performance, and optimize them based on measurable results.
-Stakeholder Alignment: You communicate priorities, compromises, and progress clearly and transparently to Business, Operations, and Leadership.
-User Focus: You incorporate the user's voice into all decisions.
-Leadership & Collaboration: You ensure close collaboration between developers, QA, design, and business stakeholders so everyone knows what matters and who is responsible for what.
-Platform Team: You shape client’s platform and process topics—from custom workflows and task management to notifications and permissions—and ensure they are specifically tailored to the requirements of insurers and MGAs.

Experience: At least 8 years of professional experience in product management. Ideally in the insurance, finance, or workflow sectors (e.g., Camunda, Celonis, n8n, etc.).
End-to-End Product Ownership: Proven experience managing the product lifecycle from discovery to market launch and in continuous improvement through data-driven methods.
Agile Methods: Solid knowledge of agile frameworks (Scrum/Kanban), backlog management, and requirements engineering.
Analytical Skills: Ability to translate complex business and technical problems into clear, actionable requirements.
Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and German (C1 level).
Tools: Practical experience with common project management tools (e.g., JIRA, Confluence, Figma, analytics tools, API documentation platforms).
Problem Solving: You thrive in complex situations, consciously and thoughtfully compromise, and drive coordination, keeping stakeholders informed as needed.
Collaboration: Proven ability to work closely with engineering, QA, design, and operations teams to deliver value incrementally and iteratively.

Human Interest is on a mission to ensure that people in all lines of work have access to retirement benefits. More than half of all working Americans are not saving enough for their future. Too often, it’s because they are employed by a company that doesn’t offer a retirement plan.

Human Interest is changing that by making it affordable and accessible for small and medium-sized businesses to offer employees a path to financial independence through retirement savings. We’re a high-growth fintech company changing the retirement industry. We are backed by a number of investors.

This includes funding from Marshall Wace and Baillie Gifford, as well as top investors such as BlackRock , TPG (The Rise Fund) , SoftBank, Glynn Capital , NewView Capital, USVP, Wing, Uncork, and more. About the role Product management is changing.

The best product managers no longer just write requirements and wait for engineering; they prototype their own ideas, pressure-test them with data, and use AI to move from problem to validated solution in days rather than quarters.

We are looking for senior product managers who have internalized that shift and who want to apply it to one of the biggest unsolved problems in America: helping working people save for retirement.

You will own the product strategy for a meaningful surface area, lead a roadmap for a dedicated engineering team, and partner across Engineering, Design, Operations, Revenue, Customer Success, and Compliance to deliver accurate, timely, and transparent outcomes at scale.

You will do this as an AI-augmented builder: using modern AI tooling both to sharpen how you work and to shape products that increasingly work on our customers’ behalf. What you get to do every day Own the vision and strategy for your product area end to end.

Set a clear, opinionated direction, define the outcomes that matter, and rally your team and stakeholders behind a roadmap that delivers a great customer experience while achieving business goals and satisfying regulatory requirements.

Define and own the goals that measure success, quantify the business impact of what you ship, and rigorously track and report progress on a weekly and monthly basis. Produce artifacts that unblock engineering teams to deliver high-quality work on time.

Partner with other product teams so your solutions deliver a great end-to-end platform experience, not just a strong local one. Dig into the data from first principles, form a point of view, and use it to validate assumptions and drive decisions.

Navigate tradeoffs and negotiate timelines with internal and external stakeholders, communicating with precision in both writing and conversation. How you work with AI We expect our senior product managers to use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster, and to bring good judgment about where AI belongs in the product itself. Prototype rapidly.

Use tools such as Figma Make, Claude Code, Codex, or similar to explore, validate, and demonstrate new ideas yourself, so you can align a team on direction with a working artifact rather than a document. Compress the busywork .

Apply AI to speed up research synthesis, requirements drafting, data exploration, and analysis so you spend your time on judgment, strategy, and customer understanding. Build AI into the product.

Identify where copilots, agents, and intelligent automation genuinely improve the customer experience, and partner with engineering on what to build and how it should behave across success, failure, and edge cases.

What you bring to the role Experience: 5+ years of product management experience, including owning a roadmap for a dedicated engineering team in a technical product area. Experience with financial or other regulated products is a strong plus.

AI fluency: Demonstrated, hands-on use of AI tools to build and transform how you work, not just as a chatbot. You are comfortable vibe-coding front-end and UX changes yourself, and you can point to prototypes or interfaces where AI meaningfully changed the outcome or the pace. Builder mindset: High agency and high urgency.

You own problems end to end, turn zero-to-one ideas into real products, and do whatever it takes to execute complex projects. Technical partnership: You have partnered closely with engineers on complex systems at scale, can self-sufficiently root-cause issues, and can propose credible fixes.

Analytical rigor: You are data-driven and think from first principles, and you are equally excited about 100 percent accuracy and 99 percent timeliness. Business acumen: You enjoy digging into how a business works, identifying how to make it better, and building product and technical solutions to do so.

Communication: Crisp, high-attention-to-detail written and verbal communication, with the ability to make complex technical concepts clear to any audience. Education: Degree in Computer Science, Business, or a related field.

Why you will love working at Human Interest Human Interest is tackling one of our country's biggest challenges - closing the retirement gap. You'll be instrumental in architecting and scaling solutions that bring financial security to employees at small and medium-sized businesses nationwide.

We’ve made significant progress, but there is still growth ahead, offering you a unique opportunity to solve complex problems, drive innovation, and advance your career alongside a dedicated, mission-driven team. We value hard work and recognize that our team's contributions are key to our continued success.

Join Human Interest and make a lasting impact by shaping the future of retirement. Our operating principles define how we work together as a team. They reflect Human Interest ’s unique view on what’s important and what’s right. Documenting this core aspect of our culture helps employees make good decisions on their own.

It also helps candidates considering career opportunities critically evaluate whether they will thrive at Human Interest . Customer obsession : We're all about creating amazing experiences for our customers. We put their needs first and go the extra mile to make them smile.

Long-Term Orientation : We're not just playing for today; we're building a legacy. We think big, plan strategically, and invest in our future. Autonomous and Accountable Teams : We trust our team members to take ownership and make smart decisions. We empower you to be your best self!

An Escalating Bar for Talent and Performance : We're constantly raising the bar and challenging ourselves to be better. We believe in growth and continuous improvement. Fundamental Optimism : We see the glass as half full (and then we fill it up with more amazing ideas!). We believe in the power of positivity and the potential for greatness.

About JerseySTEM All JerseySTEM roles are pro-bono (unpaid) positions. JerseySTEM is a mission-driven professional network of pro-bono contributors dedicated to improving access to STEM education and career pathways for underserved middle school girls in New Jersey.

Members contribute their professional skills and leverage their networks in service of the organization’s gender-equity agenda.Membership is a minimum six-month commitment of approximately six flexible hours per week and includes a $100 refundable deposit, returned after six months of active membership.

K–12 educators, retirees, veterans, interns, and students are exempt from the deposit. Overview Please note: This is an unpaid position. JerseySTEM is seeking skilled Agile Product Owners to help implement and execute transformational organization outcomes.

The candidate will have demonstrated expertise and application of Agile methodologies, techniques and frameworks, a successful track record of driving and facilitating teams, commitment to continuous learning and mindset of relentless improvement.

Candidates will be evaluated by JerseySTEM 's Operational Excellence Management team which includes a technical committee of Agile coaches and business managers.

Candidates will focus on one of following domains: Outreach Information System : Built around a backbone of Salesforce augmented by a series of supplemental applications such as Email marketing integration, Quickbooks integration,...the OIS-PO will oversee the evolution of the current solution as the needs evolve and new integrations become available.

Human Resources Information System : Established around the Applicant Tracking System (iCIMS) and the Onboarding platform (Enboarder), the Product own will shepherd the evolution of our information system supporting the Human Capital department.

(HRIS-PO) Responsibilities What can you expect in a Product Owner role at JerseySTEM : Organize and oversee the requirement gathering and Business Analysis of the solutions to be developed.

Manage and prioritize the product backlog for an Agile team Attend weekly meetings with the team Work with stakeholders to understand their needs, and with the team to understand technical and practical constraints Help clarify user stories, set acceptance criteria, answer questions Review the team's progress periodically, and adjust the backlog as needed Identify process and communications issues Minimum time commitment: 5-7 hours/ week with committed work times, for a minimum 6 months period.

Qualifications Technical Qualifications: 3-4 years of experience as Product Owner or Project Manager in a Corporate setting preferred Proven track record as a PO or Product Manager Excellent communication, analytical, mentoring and problem-solving skills Certified Product Owner (CSPO) , PMP, SAFe certifications preferred Experience using Jira, Kanban Board, Slack Originally posted on Himalayas

Über uns
Bei VREY bauen wir das EnergyOS für Mehrfamilienhäuser .
In Deutschland stehen über 3,3 Millionen Mehrparteienhäuser – und sie sind das schwarze Loch der Energiewende. <1% Solardurchdringung. <2% Smart Metering. Kaum Flexibilität oder intelligentes Energiemanagement.
Gleichzeitig zwingt die Regulierung Eigentümer zu massiven Investitionen: Solar wird zur Pflicht, Smart Meter müssen in den nächsten 5 Jahren flächendeckend ausgerollt werden, Heizung und Mobilität elektrifizieren sich. Das Mehrfamilienhaus wird vom Betongold zum aktiven Teil der dezentralen Energieinfrastruktur.
Was fehlt, ist ein integriertes System, das diesen Wandel wirtschaftlich und operativ beherrschbar macht.
VREY kombiniert zertifizierten Messstellenbetrieb mit eigener Software und ermöglicht Eigentümern erstmals, ihren selbst erzeugten Solarstrom direkt an ihre Mieter zu verkaufen – einfach und ohne selbst zum Energieversorger zu werden (§42b EnWG).
Damit wird regulatorischer Zwang zu einer profitablen und planbaren Chance:
Zweistellige Renditen und Wertsteigerung für Eigentümer,
~20 % Stromkostenersparnis für Mieter, und
digitale Infrastruktur für Speicher, Wärmepumpen und Flexibilität.
Bereits heute betreuen wir eine dreistellige Anzahl an Projekten - darunter die größten Bestandshalter und Wohnungsbaugenossenschaften - in allen 16 Bundesländern. Damit gehören wir nach kürzester Zeit zu den führenden Anbietern im Markt.
Im Zuge unserer Seed-Finanzierung haben wir 3,3 Mio. € von führenden Impact- und Energy-VCs (u. a. Rubio Impact Ventures, HTGF, Kopa Ventures) eingesammelt. Mit dem frischen Kapital gehen wir in die nächste Wachstumsphase und bauen unser Team gezielt aus.
Wir stehen am Anfang eines strukturellen Marktumbruchs. Wer heute die Energieinfrastruktur im Mehrfamilienhaus definiert, prägt sie für Jahrzehnte. Werde Teil von VREY und baue mit uns das führende EnergyOS.

Riverlane’s mission is to master quantum error correction (QEC) and unlock a new age of human progress. From advances in material and climate science, to complex chemistry simulation for new drug design, quantum computers will help humanity solve some of its most important challenges.

Having raised more than $125M in funding to date to accelerate our cutting-edge R&D in quantum error correction (QEC), Riverlane partners with many of the world’s leading quantum hardware providers and government agencies to make fault tolerant quantum computing a reality. We’re making remarkable progress and growing fast.

Deltakit is Riverlane’s open-source software development kit (SDK) for QEC which is designed to help researchers build, test and run QEC workflows as the field of quantum computing rapidly evolves.
You’ll sit right at the heart of Deltakit, working closely with users, partners and cross-functional teams to deeply understand real-world challenges and translate them into a compelling product direction. The Opportunity
As Product Manager - Merchant Experience, you will own the discovery, definition, and delivery of Xplor 's self-serve merchant portal: the place where merchants see their transactions and payouts, understand their fees, pull reports, and manage their account.

It is the everyday face of Xplor 's payments platform, and your job is to make it clear, trustworthy, and genuinely useful across global markets. This portal also acts as the internal platform our own teams use to support and configure those merchants.
You will sit at the intersection of product craft, payments, and data - turning information owned by the billing, payout, and financials teams into an experience that answers a merchant's most important questions at a glance: have I been paid, what did it cost me, and is my account set up the way I need? You will partner closely with design and research, and with the upstream teams whose data you surface.

Merchant Portal Strategy & Roadmap
Own and evolve the strategy and roadmap for Xplor 's self-serve merchant portal across global markets.
Define a vision for a merchant experience that is clear, trustworthy, and reduces the need to contact support.
Prioritise ruthlessly against merchant impact, adoption, and support deflection, and present priorities to the VP of Product.
Align your roadmap with the billing, payout, and financials teams whose data the portal surfaces.
Transactions, Payouts & Reporting
Own the surfaces where merchants view transactions and payouts.
Define clear, accurate reporting and statements that merchants can pull themselves, without raising a ticket.
Make fees and deductions transparent, so merchants understand their cost of payments.
Ensure the money shown to merchants is accurate and reconciled with the underlying platform data.
Account Management & Self-Serve
Own merchant self-service: managing account details, users and permissions, and settings without contacting support.
Identify the highest-volume support reasons that the portal should be able to deflect, and design self-serve flows to remove them.
Build in-product help and guidance that meets merchants where they are.
Track and reduce support contact rates for portal-addressable issues as a core metric.
Merchant Configuration & Enablement
Own the configuration portal the BMS team uses to set up and maintain merchants: pricing, fees, product configuration, and account settings.
Own and drive the capabilities of our configuration portal to remove work out of engineering and into the hands of the team closest to the merchant, with the guardrails that money-affecting changes require.
Define validation, approvals, and change history for pricing and fee changes, so a mistake is hard to make and easy to trace.
Work with the billing, payout, and financials teams to make sure configuration set internally is reflected accurately in what the merchant sees and is charged.
Experience, Craft & Adoption
Partner closely with design and engineering to ship intuitive, well-crafted experiences grounded in real merchant needs.
Run discovery with merchants to understand their jobs-to-be-done and validate solutions before building.
Use product analytics to understand behaviour, find friction, and measure the impact of what you ship.
Drive adoption and engagement of the portal, improving task success and merchant satisfaction over time.
AI-Augmented Product Practice
Embed AI tools into every stage of the product lifecycle: use LLMs for rapid synthesis of merchant interviews and support-ticket themes, competitor teardowns, and PRD first drafts; use AI assistants to prototype portal flows and copy without full engineering overhead.
Champion AI adoption across the product team - document effective prompting patterns, share workflows, and upskill peers.
Use AI-powered analytics to surface friction and anomalies in portal usage data and generate plain-language summaries for stakeholders.
Stay current with the evolving AI tooling landscape relevant to product management, operating at a higher output cadence than a traditional PM.
Delivery & Stakeholder Management
Drive agile delivery with engineering, design, and data using clear PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
Manage dependencies with the billing, payout, financials, and data teams whose information the portal surfaces.
Coordinate with support and partner teams to make sure the portal reflects what merchants actually need.
Monitor product health via metrics such as adoption, task success, support deflection, and merchant satisfaction.

### **V-ZUG Procurement** ###
Der Bereich Procurement verantwortet die strategische Beschaffung von Materialien, Komponenten und Dienstleistungen entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette. Als Schweizer Premiumhersteller mit eigener Produktion am Hauptsitz in Zug stellen wir hohe Anforderungen an unsere Lieferanten - und an uns selbst.

### **Das bietet dir die Stelle** ###
* Du entwickelst und setzt die Warengruppen- und Lieferantenstrategie für deine Kategorien um - nicht als Verwaltungsaufgabe, sondern als echte Gestaltungsaufgabe: Du entscheidest, welche Lieferanten V-ZUG langfristig begleiten, wo neue Quellen erschlossen werden und wie die Materialversorgung auch in einem volatilen Markt stabil bleibt
* Du steuerst dein Lieferantenportfolio über den gesamten Lebenszyklus - von der Auswahl neuer Partner über gezielte Weiterentwicklung bis zur Ausphasung. Gemeinsam mit dem Supplier Quality Management sorgst du dafür, dass Anspruch und Realität übereinstimmen - durch regelmässige Bewertungen und Audits, die mehr sind als ein Pflichtprogramm
* Du verantwortest das Vertragsmanagement in deinen zugewiesenen Warengruppen im Bereich Mechanik - von der Erstellung über die Verhandlung bis zur laufenden Pflege. Du weisst, was in einem Vertrag wirklich zählt, und bringst interne Stakeholder auf einen gemeinsamen Nenner
* Du führst Ausschreibungen durch, vergleichst Angebote und entwickelst gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen fundierte Vergabeempfehlungen und Entscheidungen, die wirtschaftliche und technische Anforderungen optimal vereinen
* Du hast die Kostenentwicklung deiner Vorserien- und Serienartikel im Griff: Du erkennst Potenziale frühzeitig, nutzt sie konsequent und setzt Massnahmen um, die nachhaltig wirken
* Du bist fester Bestandteil von Projekten, koordinierst Materialbedarfe mit Lieferanten und stellst sicher, dass Muster, Prototypen und Serienmaterialien dann da sind, wenn sie gebraucht werden
### **Das bringst du für die Stelle mit** ###
* Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Betriebswirtschaft, Supply Chain Management oder einer vergleichbaren Disziplin
* Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im Einkauf mit und weisst, wie man Lieferanten gegenüber souverän Position bezieht - mit Verhandlungsgeschick, das nicht laut sein muss, um zu wirken, und einer Kommunikation, die intern wie extern ankommt
* Du denkst strategisch und analytisch: Du erkennst Marktdynamiken, leitest daraus konkrete Massnahmen ab und entwickelst Einkaufsstrategien, die nicht nur für heute, sondern für morgen tragen
* Du weisst, wofür du stehst und bringst die Klarheit, Durchsetzungsstärke und Überzeugungskraft mit, um das auch zu zeigen: im internen Projektumfeld genauso wie im Gespräch mit externen Partnern
* Der sichere Umgang mit ERP-Systemen, insbesondere SAP, sowie digitalen Tools ist für dich selbstverständlich - kein Aufwand, sondern Arbeitsgrundlage
* Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch - schriftlich wie mündlich, klar und mit dem richtigen Gespür dafür, was dein Gegenüber braucht

About Wolt
At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.
Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.
We're looking for a Product Manager to own our search experience that millions of customers land on when they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo, and the single biggest lever we have on what they find.
The role sits in our Core Consumer organisation in the Search domain, which is responsible for the in-app experience. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA markets, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around.
Search is where customers tell us exactly what they want. Getting it right across restaurants, grocery, and retail - in every language we operate in - is one of the highest-intent and hardest problems in the app.
What you'll work on
Query understanding, Autosuggestions and AI/ML problems in the Search domain
Where conversational and agentic search changes how customers get to a decision.
Making search work across three brands, multiple languages, and query behaviour that differs market by market.
Our humble expectations
We're looking for a product leader more than a feature owner. Someone who can find the problems that matter most, for customers and for the business, and make the case for solving them.
You bring proven experience as a Product Manager in Consumer, or on another relevance- or ranking-driven consumer experience.
You demonstrate fluency with search measurement and know how to actually move it.
You show strong product judgment, backed by data literacy and customer insight.
You work backwards from the customer problem, and you can weigh that against the most urgent business problems at the same time, rather than treating it as a side you have to pick.
You think strategically: you can zoom out to where the domain should be in two years, then zoom back in on what we should ship next quarter.
You're comfortable with ambiguity and genuinely flexible. This industry is changing fast, AI most of all, and the plan we write in January won't be the plan in June.
You work deeply with ML and engineering on relevance and ranking, without needing to be an ML expert yourself.
You're curious about what AI actually changes for customers, and you can tell real value from hype.
You build a case and bring people with you: engineering, design, analytics, and local market teams across three brands and many markets.
You do your best work with range: global platform thinking one week, a specific market's reality the next.
Next steps
The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

Transforme sua carreira com o iFood ! Somos uma empresa brasileira de tecnologia referência na América Latina. Who we are
Help Scout started in 2011 with a simple premise: support software should treat customers like people, not tickets. 3+ billion conversations later, more than 10,000 companies use Help Scout to grow relationships with customers of all types, from clients to patients and beyond.
Now we’re in a new chapter: not only building AI that gives teams more space to focus on the customer experience, but also reimagining how we operate in an AI-native world. That means shipping and learning faster, without compromising on craft. Great work here carries a strong opinion and sweats the details, regardless of the tools we use to drive it.
We’ve been a fully remote team since day one, with 120+ teammates now all over the world. It’s a culture where you’ll be trusted to take ownership, stay curious, and raise the quality of work around you. It comes with clear expectations and a team that will push you to do some of the best work of your career.
If that kind of challenge gives you energy, we’d love to meet you.

Help Scout has earned something most software companies never get: genuine trust. More than 10,000 businesses use us, and a remarkable share of them arrived because someone they respect recommended Help Scout. Our brand reputation is the foundation for something bigger.
The support industry is changing shape, and a key part of Help Scout's future growth will come from outcome-based products: resolutions handled, drafts sent, actions taken on behalf of a customer. Making sure customers discover those, see value in them, and build habits around them is a key part of the impact of your role.
Growth at Help Scout spans the entire customer journey: turning sign-ups into trials, how quickly a trial gets set up to see value, and how customers who love one part of Help Scout find their way into the products they aren't using yet.

You'll own the vision, roadmap, and execution for the Growth workstream in partnership with design and engineering.
That starts with sharpening the core funnel: signup, onboarding, trial-to-paid conversion, and the activation moments that turn a trial into a team that can't imagine working without Help Scout.
Second, help strengthen the expansion motion for our AI product lines. Every surface of the product should help customers discover and adopt what's next for them, and you'll own how that works.
Third, scale growth capability across the org. You'll set up the frameworks, metrics, and experiment practices that let other teams run their own growth work, so growth thinking is embedded everywhere rather than concentrated in one workstream.
You'll report to Scott Rocher, our Chief Product Officer.
Note: This role is open to US-based applicants only.
This role is currently open to consideration at 2 levels. The compensation range reflects the range across both levels.

Own the full growth roadmap: signup, onboarding, activation, trial-to-paid conversion, and in-product expansion into our AI product lines
Build and run a high-tempo experimentation practice, with the discipline to know when a result is signal and when it's noise
Design how customers discover and adopt new products from inside Help Scout, partnering closely with the PMs who own each product line
Go after big opportunities, not just optimizations. Some of the highest-impact growth work will be things we've never done before
Build the growth model, experiment standards, and playbooks that let teams across the company ship growth work with confidence, without routing every call through you
Bring strategic input to pricing and packaging decisions alongside product, marketing, and finance
Spend real time with customers and in the data, translating what you learn into insight the whole company can act on
Work with marketing, sales, and CS so the growth motion is coherent across the full customer lifecycle

You've spent 5+ years in Product with direct experience leading growth in B2B SaaS with a free trial or freemium motion, and you know how to get customers to the moment where the product's value is undeniable
You love data, and you're hands-on with it. You define the metrics, design the experiments, and you're honest about what the numbers do and don't say
You think in outcomes, not features. "Activated teams" and "expansion revenue" are more interesting to you than "new onboarding flow launched"
You build systems, not just wins. The frameworks and playbooks you leave behind make everyone around you faster
You're genuinely fluent with AI tools and treat them as part of your craft — for research synthesis, strategy testing, rapid prototyping, and customer signal analysis. You have a point of view on where these tools are heading and how they're changing the shape of PM work
You understand that when execution is cheap, judgment is the bottleneck. Your highest-leverage hours are spent on strategy and prioritization — defining what's next and what's not — not on driving the build
You're an excellent writer. Help Scout runs on writing, and you make your thinking visible in one-pagers, briefs, and narratives that move decisions forward
You lead through influence and trust. This is an individual contributor role, and the best growth work happens when engineers, designers, and marketers want to run with you
You've worked in B2B SaaS and understand the difference between building for support teams vs. building for end consumers
Company values
Happy to Help
Help is in our first name! We show up for each other — not out of obligation, but because we’re invested in the team’s collective success. We share knowledge freely, lead with generosity, and practice empathy with our teammates, customers, and community.
Craft over Convention
Our success relies on the quality and craft of the work we put into the world. The status quo simply won’t work. So we insist on narrow focus, sweating every detail, and relentless pursuit of customer delight.
Progress not Perfection
Achieving our true potential — collectively and individually — requires constant progress and forward momentum. By creating a culture of curiosity and openness, we aim to create a safe space for mistakes, the ability to identify them quickly, and use them to get better.
Own the Outcome
Own the outcome means taking full responsibility for the results of your work, decisions, and contributions. It reflects a mindset of accountability, proactiveness, and follow-through. If you “own the outcome,” you don’t just complete tasks, you ensure your work leads to meaningful results, and take initiative to solve problems rather than passing them along.
Read more about how we define, share, and live these values here .

A home office stipend to help you get set up and productive

The opportunity in front of us is to invert that: to move from point solutions to one deepening relationship with each customer, where we understand them holistically across all of their concerns, help them navigate what to do, and let the individual treatments become secondary to the relationship itself.
That shift is what this role owns. It's a true 0-to-1 build, but not a cold start. You'll define a brand-new, relationship-first product experience that spans our existing categories and the new ones we create to support it, with everything we've already built as your foundation.

Picture a concierge-style experience for the person who knows they don't feel their best, wants to feel better, and is looking for a trusted guide rather than another one-off transaction: lab testing, continuous care, and access to treatment, wrapped into one experience that compounds over time.
This is a rare seat. We're a company known for physical product and transactional care, making the leap to a sticky, engagement-driven, relationship-driven digital experience. Few established companies reach that moment, and fewer put a single person at the center of it. You'll work across the entire company to define what it looks like, and you'll do it on top of the AI infrastructure we're building, as someone who works that way themselves.

Own the end-to-end consumer experience for this new relationship-first offering, from discovery and onboarding through ongoing engagement
Define the synthesis layer across our existing categories, and stand up the new product lines the offering needs
Partner with engineering and design to build AI into the core of the consumer experience
Partner with our clinical teams so protocols, safety, and education are core to the product experience
Shape short- and long-term roadmaps, driving long-term scalability while balancing day-to-day improvements
Operate with focus in a fast-growing, constantly evolving environment, where there are always more opportunities than resources

6+ years of product management experience, working collaboratively across cross-functional teams
A track record of building and shipping consumer products that customers love and that drive meaningful business impact
A strong, specific point of view on where AI can meaningfully reshape the consumer healthcare experience, and the excitement to build it into the core of the product
Fluency with AI agents and AI-native workflows. AI-native is your default operating mode: you work with agents the way most PMs work with docs, fluently and constantly
Strategic and tactical range: you can set the vision and also design and execute scalable processes from scratch, ideally in an operations-intensive environment
Strong communication and a low-ego, high-EQ style. You build alignment, partner well across functions, and bring people with you. This is a fully remote role, so clear written communication and proactive collaboration matter

As we continue to expand our Finance portfolio, we're looking for a high-impact Product Manager to help shape and execute the product vision across one or more enterprise SaaS products serving the financial services industry.

This is an opportunity to work with mature products, long-standing enterprise customers, and cross-functional global teams while driving meaningful product innovation. This role operates across one or more portfolio companies within the Embrace Finance Group.

As a Product Manager, you will work closely with stakeholders from the assigned portfolio company while collaborating with Embrace leadership to execute product strategy, drive delivery excellence, and align product initiatives with broader portfolio objectives.

You will regularly communicate product progress, roadmap updates, delivery status, risks, and strategic recommendations to both portfolio company stakeholders and Embrace leadership. AI-First Product Management At Embrace, we operate with an AI-first mindset .

We expect Product Managers to use AI effectively in their day-to-day work to improve productivity, accelerate product delivery, enhance decision-making, and create greater value for customers and the business. The ideal candidate combines strategic product thinking with strong execution capabilities.

They will own product strategy, customer engagement, roadmap planning, and agile delivery while serving as the bridge between customers, business stakeholders, and engineering teams.

Product Strategy & Vision

Customer & Market Engagement

With fewer C-sections and higher VBAC success rates, our research-backed approach is delivering better outcomes. Our team of trusted midwives, OBGYNs, and dedicated care navigators ensure our patients get the type of care they need in the moments that matter most.
Since launching in 2021, we’ve expanded to include Preconception and Miscarriage Care, Pregnancy Care, Postpartum Support, and Gynecology. We currently have 4 clinics in the tri-state area, with three new clinics opening in 2026! Come join our team of clinicians, innovators, operators, and technologists passionate about setting a new standard in maternity care.

Product Manager
Full-Time
New York, Chicago or Charlotte
Reports to VP, Central Operations
About Oula
Oula Health is a venture-backed, midwifery-led maternity and GYN care company building the next generation of women's healthcare. We partner exclusively with major health systems — including Mount Sinai, Stamford Health, and Novant Health — to embed our collaborative OB-GYN and midwifery model directly inside their networks. We're a team of ~100 people at Series B stage, with 4 clinics today and three more opening in 2026.

At Oula, our product doesn't sit alongside our EHR — it integrates directly into it. Every product and engineering decision has downstream consequences for how our EHRs are configured, and every EHR configuration decision shapes what's possible on the product side. Someone has to hold both at once.
We're looking for a technically-minded Product Manager to own and evolve our core technology stack — including our EHR, patient portal, and care management platform. This role sits at the intersection of product, operations, and health system integration, serving as the internal and external subject matter expert on our EMR and the primary lead for health system EHR integrations.
You'll manage the day-to-day health of our tech stack, partnering closely with both internal teams and external health system stakeholders to ensure our systems run smoothly and our integrations deliver.

You can sit with a midwife and understand why a clinical template matters, then turn around and write a bug ticket that engineering can actually action, then build the SOP so the next market launch doesn't require you to be in the room. When things are ambiguous (and they often are), you'll lean in rather than wait for clarity.
What You'll Own
EHR Configuration & Clinical Systems
Own day-to-day management of our core tech stack: the EHR, patient portal, and care management platform
Own Athena and Epic configuration end to end: clinical templates, order sets, lab configurations, payer connectivity, and access management for clinical and ops staff
Lead EHR integration efforts as the internal and external subject matter expert — FHIR/HL7 data exchange, health system IT coordination and committed go-live timelines
Own and accelerate Epic integration timelines as we onboard additional health system partners
Maintain configuration integrity as new markets launch and care model workflows evolve
Partner with our IT team on infrastructure; own the clinical systems layer they don't touch
Product Operations & Launch
Own bug intake and prioritization from Market Operations — standardize how Engineering receives, scopes, and resolves issues and communicates status back to the field
Build structured launch toolkits and training materials so clinic teams are prepared for new feature rollouts on day one
Coordinate end-to-end launches across Product, Engineering, and Operations
Identify where AI and automation can reduce manual administrative burden in product operations workflows
Standards & Knowledge Management
Build and maintain the clinical systems SOP library so new market setup is repeatable — documented well enough that a new hire can execute without you in the room
Develop onboarding materials for clinic managers and clinical staff on EHR workflows and tooling
Drive feature parity efforts so patients and clinicians experience a consistent standard of care across markets
Data & Reporting
Build and maintain dashboards tracking feature adoption, issue resolution, and rollout health across clinics
Develop quarterly reporting for Product, leadership, and health system partners on platform performance
Ensure data infrastructure is in place to measure the impact of every feature rollout

3+ years with product operations, technical program management, or PM-adjacent work — ideally at a growth-stage digital health or services company
Strong problem-solving instincts and genuine curiosity — you like figuring out how things work and making them work better
Ease with ambiguity and a bias toward action; this role requires you to create the playbook, not execute someone else's
Demonstrated ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments and drive aggressive timelines — ideally with client-facing or health system-facing experience
Ability to speak ‘multiple languages’ – comfort going deep on technical details while communicating clearly to non-technical audiences; you can write a bug ticket, an SOP, and a launch plan that people actually follow; hands-on EHR configuration and integration experience strongly preferred
Analytical enough to build a dashboard and identify a pattern, even if you're not a SQL expert
What Success Looks Like
In your first 90 days, you've audited our current Athena configuration, identified gaps, and have a remediation plan. You understand the bug triage process well enough to have improved it. You've met your counterparts at every health system partner and know what's coming for the next Epic integration.
At six months, new market launches have a repeatable systems and product checklist. Clinic teams know what to expect before a feature goes live. Bug resolution time is measurably faster and the field is no longer sending issues into a black hole.
At one year, the SOP library is comprehensive, clinical systems configuration is stable and documented, and you've successfully navigated at least one new health system EHR environment. The product team has a reliable partner and the ops team isn't dependent on any single person for systems knowledge.
